rca of the issue.bug: iteration_36 CRITICAL — POST /api/doc-template/preview 500 for kind=quotation when terms contained <i style=..>/<b class=..>/<br .../> from Chrome contentEditable.
rca of the issue.reproduction: curl POST /api/doc-template/preview {kind:'quotation', quotation_terms:'x'} previously → 500 text/plain (reportlab paraparser 'saw instead of expected '). Now returns 200 application/pdf.
rca of the issue.root_cause: Whitelist regex in _clean_terms only kept bare <b>/<i>/<u> opening tags; attributed variants were stripped while bare closings were kept, producing unbalanced markup for reportlab.
rca of the issue.mitigation:
Main agent added normalization step in _clean_terms that rewrites <(/?)(b|i|u)(\s[^>]*)?> → <\1\2> and
→
before the strip pass. Verified via 14 pytest cases and full E2E UI flow.
